content.text:
The members page needs to put funding information immediately below the MP's name. Today, it opens with identity and membership facts, followed by a mixed list of recent declarations. Amounts and funder links appear inside individual records, so visitors have to assemble the picture themselves. The current view is in [EntityDetails.svelte](/Users/jamie/development/exposed/frontend/src/EntityDetails.svelte:69).

I recommend a compact identity header, a funding overview, a recent declarations feed, and a way to explore the full stored history.

| Visitor's question | Proposed change |
|---|---|
| How much has this MP declared? | Show known monetary totals by currency, with an explicit category scope and stored date range. Show how many entries lack an amount or currency beside the total. |
| What donations have they declared recently? | Default the recent feed to donations and other support. Each item should show the funder, value, payment type, registration date, category, and a link to supporting evidence where available. |
| Who supports them repeatedly? | Show funders ranked by known value and number of declarations. Clicking a funder should reveal the underlying records for this MP. |
| Are there patterns over time? | Add a simple monthly or quarterly view of declared value and declaration counts. Selecting a period should filter the records below it. |
| Can I check the whole history? | Provide paginated history with date, category, and funder filters. Keep overview totals, charts, and records tied to the same selected scope. |

The wording around totals needs care. An aggregate of earnings, gifts, loans, and donations is not a donation total or necessarily money received personally by the MP. Offer a clearly named donations-and-support scope, with other categories selectable. Use “known declared value” and show the stored date range until completeness has been established. Keep currencies separate; a missing value must never become zero.

These totals require backend work. The member service currently requests only the latest 20 declarations, so summing the cards in the browser would produce a misleading total. See [entity_details.rs](/Users/jamie/development/exposed/exposed/src/lib/domain/services/entity_details.rs:20). Recent donation filtering must also happen before that limit, otherwise other categories can crowd donations out of the feed.

For “recently declared,” registration dates are sufficient. Label the timeline accordingly, rather than suggesting it shows when money changed hands. The current page already displays registration dates, amounts, currencies, and funder links in [EntityDetails.svelte](/Users/jamie/development/exposed/frontend/src/EntityDetails.svelte:102). Repeat-funder results should acknowledge that unresolved or split identities can affect grouping.

Build the scoped backend summary and paginated history first, then the compact header, totals, and recent feed. Ship those core stories before adding the funder ranking and time chart. Audit the retained source data for usable evidence links and descriptions alongside that work.

Acceptance checks should include an MP with more than 20 declarations, mixed currencies, missing values, loans, and repeated funders. Totals must reconcile with all matching stored entries; recent donations must remain visible despite newer unrelated records; chart and funder selections must open the exact contributing records. On desktop and mobile, visitors should see the funding overview and the start of the recent feed without scrolling through a large profile header.
